title: Note: the windows — the root cause, this time

text: On Windows, a process started 'hidden' has no console, and every child it starts then opens a visible one. That flag was on six spawners here, so grandchildren — server restarts, test copies, Claude hooks — popped windows. Now the roots get a hidden console that everything below inherits, nothing below hides itself, and every hidden server is restarted on the new code. A last burst was possible during that restart (18:23-25). If one appears after 18:26, tell me the title.
